notes.text:
Claim and domain. Let k be any countable algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero field, X reduced irreducible geometrically unibranch projective, and L an actual ample rational line bundle. For a projective birational resolution pi:Y→X with smooth integral projective source, genuine pullback identifies PSH(X,L) and PSH(Y,pi*L), with their divisorial topologies and original suprema. Consequently normalized target PSH is compact and c1(L) has EP. This establishes the entire countable antecedent of the task-granted cardinality implication.

Granted mathematical assumptions. We use only the supplied accepted partial bodies within their binding scopes: fixed-reference all-point fiber constancy, actual-reference local semiample conversion, geometric completion and domination of the one proper birational witness, and repaired countable original-ring affine regularization with its projective consequence. The fixed-perturbation body has binding 447cf79483e6119171585b3630fd53890a9899fad848a9de11495db70b981877 and curve-current addendum c8e83ff56c71a8c3d7ecd1e67733f51e57a741883ba84d841e0003f5bc5bcdf6. The geometric body has binding 1b6a3ffdf27b45f892f0bc1e225c721ecb01d4938fe3abeeed1604ac10905eb5. The repaired affine body has binding 2cac3d27263a2230a409f375c4d1b94c12bfd5f5e007d5bf35d9e1f98cc52ecb, with repair c589d09159ecf118494dd677d02d0ae80ad6148dd44739abfc1f2be43cdbd402. These grants do not themselves grant the new join or singular EP. They are input assumptions, not registered note supports.

Resolution and all-point descent. The finite-type characteristic-zero integral target satisfies the Noetherian, quasi-excellent, generically reduced over-Q hypotheses of Temkin0904.1592v2 Theorem1.2.1, https://arxiv.org/pdf/0904.1592v2. Its finite blowup resolution is projective birational, preserves the regular locus, and ends in a regular variety, smooth over perfect k. Integral blowup charts retain the original function field. Factor normal Y through the actual normalization Xnu. The proper birational normal-base Stein application has every source generic point dominating the base. The normalization of geometrically unibranch X is a universal homeomorphism, so geometric connectedness transfers to every original target fiber. This is algebraic factorization; onto psh transport is not assumed.

For genuine phi on pi*L, fix one actual very ample A and use valid pairs (i,delta), with the approximating scalar phi_i placed in PSH(pi*L+delta*A) by adding zero in its ample difference class. Pull actual fixed-bundle FS formulas to a smooth proper curve in a geometric fiber before uniform limits. The pi*L reference is constant on a graph model, whereas A has one fixed positive finite curvature sigma_A. The exact current identity is dd^c v_(i,delta)=mu_(i,delta)−delta*sigma_A, with mu nonnegative. Interior Green corrections have zero boundary values and norm at most B_V delta. The corrected functions need not decrease. Compact emptiness of decreasing boundary superlevel sets compares the original net with harmonic tests; letting delta tend to zero gives comparison for its limit. Bounded floors are subharmonic and constant on proper connected curves; decreasing the floor includes minus infinity. Every analytic fiber point has a norm-preserving rational lift after an independent Gauss extension and completed algebraic closure. Curve-morphism chains compare this lift to one fixed original closed point. Thus constancy holds at every analytic point, without an argument from density and usc. Proper analytic surjectivity gives an usc psi with phi=psi∘pi, finite at the generic trivial valuation and bounded above.

Original frames and growth. Choose qL very ample, generated by s_0,…,s_N. On U_i=D(s_i), the original coordinate ring is generated by s_j/s_i. Put rho_i=q^(−1) max_j log|s_j/s_i|. The constant ratio makes rho_i nonnegative, and bounded simultaneous generator-seminorm domains are compact. Hence rho_i is a proper original-ring affine FS exhaustion. Canonical section norms are at most one at valuation-ring centers, and a generating section is a unit there. Therefore the zero-weight global potential is zero and rho_i=−q^(−1)log||s_i||_triv. Its pullback is the exact pulled reference. The raw function u_i=psi+rho_i is usc, locally bounded above, generically finite and at most B+rho_i.

Contact and witness antecedents. Use the single original proper birational witness P_i=pi^(−1)(U_i)→U_i. Its source is integral, smooth and finite type; properness is relative to U_i, and finite affine source charts handle its possible nonaffineness. Actual-reference conversion gives decreasing rational affine FS nets on compact generator-bounded neighborhoods Q with ordinary interiors, in the same pulled frame. Valid ample perturbations add zero without changing the scalar. Fixed-pair approximation and summable rational shifts give decreasing finite approximants; original generator branches and a floor can be appended below their finite minimum on Q. Flattening uses compactness and strictly shifted finite continuous majorants, without assuming minimum closure.

Countability makes the source seminorm topology second countable. For each rational t, the open sets {a_alpha<t} cover {inf a_alpha<t}; choose countable subcovers and increasing upper indices. The resulting sequence has the exact original infimum, including minus infinity; cofinality is unnecessary. All approximants share the ordinary interior of Q. At a tested point, a winning nonzero regular branch is a unit on its principal neighborhood and supplies a rational unit-log support below the maximum with equality and the same additive constant. A winning floor supplies constant support. Rational shifts alter weight and support together; inactive zero branches are harmless.

For each specified smooth affine operation, the granted geometric construction embeds the original ring, retains an effective ample boundary, and dominates the entire original proper witness, including exceptional points. At a boundary blowup, the ideal contains O(−ND); for sufficiently large m≥N+1, mb*D−E is effective ample with exactly the boundary support. The reference is the actual boundary bundle with g=g0+p, and every pullback is literal. Restrictions and finite combinations retain the witness; products use P_i×A1 and the specified logarithmic floors. Common domination is used only for finite lists. Completed residue-field curve comparisons are not applications of countable affine regularization. Thus the repaired affine theorem's contact, growth, witness, reference and GEO antecedents are met.

Repaired Runge/Hartogs mechanism. The accepted whole-base trace first regularizes on the smooth good open, then identifies every bad value using a normalized horizontal line slice, its proper lift to the same witness, actual disc coordinates t=bz^e, entire compact Gauss fibers and positive canonical norm weights. Finite positive sums preserve minus-infinity limits. Pole control uses finite normalization and one f^M clearing all powers of an integral element. Countable barriers include infinite-coordinate faces and positively constructed contact replacements. Rossi is used with the tested z inside its relatively compact neighborhood V. The split argument retains one neighborhood where the clopen trace weight is a locally constant positive integer gamma, with gamma=1 treated separately. Product Runge is established before coefficient radii are used. Arbitrary-radius Gauss norms and controlled collars give original-ring regularization. Descending bad sets and every reduced singular stratum decrease dimension; the final empty-bad-set product step globalizes beyond a local cover. These are the supplied repaired proof's precise hypotheses, verified above.

New first membership. The affine theorem regularizes u_i in its original ring. Its original-reference projective consequence gives, for rational c>1, psi−(c−1)rho_i on U_i, extended by minus infinity elsewhere, genuinely in cL. At every analytic point a nonzero homogeneous coordinate is maximal, so its chart has rho_i=0. Every other defined rho_j is nonnegative. Their finite maximum is exactly psi, including minus infinity. Thus psi is cL-psh for every c>1. Apply decreasing varying-class closure to the constant scalar family psi as c decreases to one, whose generic value is finite. The individual chart extensions increase and are not the closure family. This proves genuine L-membership before target EP.

Genuine pullback follows from BJ4.7 and birational generic finiteness. Fiber constancy and first membership make it onto. Divisorial valuations of the common function field are identical, giving a homeomorphism; analytic surjectivity preserves original suprema. BJ5.20–5.21 give compact normalized PSH on smooth Y for the nef class pi*L. Transport compactness, then apply general-projective BJ5.11 to obtain EP on original X. BJ5.13 has not been used before target EP.

notes.text:
Claim. Over every algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero field k, without countability, every original reduced irreducible geometrically unibranch projective X with actual ample rational L has EP and compact normalized genuine PSH. We use n1 for the entire countable domain. This matches the exact analytic antecedent of the supplied accepted finite-data implication; that antecedent is now proved.

For a finite rational PL obstacle f, descend finitely many coefficients of X,L,f and an ample embedding to a countable algebraically closed k0⊂k. Include presentations, multiplication tables and overlaps of the actual finite normalization nu:Xnu→X, and its inverse on a dense open. Faithful flatness descends reducedness, integrality and normality of the finite source N0. A finite normal birational algebra in the common fraction field is the integral closure, so nu0 is the actual normalization. Universal-homeomorphism descent gives geometric unibranchness of X0. The embedding retains actual ample L0. The original possibly nonnormal target is preserved.

Analytic restriction X_k^an→X0^an is surjective at every point. Starting with its completed residue field, adjoin radius-one independent Gauss variables for a transcendence basis of k/k0, complete, embed the remaining algebraic extension norm-preservingly in an algebraic closure, and complete again. Every polynomial uses finitely many variables even for an infinite basis. A monic equation with nonzero constant term forces the embedded k to have trivial norm. Evaluation provides a lift with the original real-valued norm.

By n1, psi0=P(f0) is continuous genuine. Its pullback psi is continuous genuine on original L. Continuous raw curvature satisfies r_*MA_raw(psi)=MA_raw(psi0). The reference is fixed: BJ3.9 places Hdom(c1(L0)) inside H(L0) for the same bundle; BJ4.16 supplies uniform approximation without EP. BE7.14 smooths these actual FS metrics. BE8.3(iv) gives complete-field pushforward with fundamental-cycle multiplicities, and BE8.4 plus weak continuity of pushforward passes to continuous metrics. BE8.18's model Deligne proof, including dimension zero and relatively regular sections, and BJ7.23 identify this with the energy-pairing operator. No unbounded transport occurs here.

EP and the energy derivative give orthogonality on X0. For p=P(f0), P(p+t(f0−p))=p for 0≤t≤1, so the nonnegative integral of f0−p against MA_raw(p) is zero. Continuous raw pushforward transfers this integral. No inverse-image support equality is needed.

For each finite h∈Hdom(c1(L)) with h≤f, choose its actual finite same-mL generating section representation. Choose its own enlarged countable algebraically closed k_h containing k0 and those coefficients. Sections are a finite matching equalizer on affine trivializing covers; flat base change commutes with it. Faithful flatness descends vanishing of the generating evaluation cokernel. Thus h_h is genuine on that same actual bundle. Restriction surjectivity transfers h_h≤f_h. The pulled psi_h is continuous genuine, bounded and hence actual E1, without assuming EP on k_h. Raw pushforward transfers orthogonality, giving h_h≤f_h=psi_h almost everywhere for MA(psi_h). General irreducible-projective BJ10.6 domination gives h_h≤psi_h everywhere, hence h≤psi on original X_k.

For an arbitrary genuine competitor a≤f, take a decreasing Hdom majorant net h_j. For rational epsilon>0, the compact closed sets {h_j≥f+epsilon} decrease to the empty set, so an entire tail is empty. Apply the finite argument to h_j−epsilon, each with its own countable enlargement. This gives a≤psi+epsilon; decreasing epsilon gives a≤psi. Feasibility proves the exact envelope identity P_L(f)=psi. No arbitrary psh family is assigned a common field. PL density, the envelope sup-norm Lipschitz bound and genuine uniform closure give continuous envelopes for every continuous obstacle. BJ5.17 yields original EP and general BJ5.11 yields normalized compactness without metrizability. Every positive rational multiple of L is covered, providing approaching target EP before normalization onto.

Primary evidence. BJ https://arxiv.org/pdf/1801.08229v4: LF1692–1729,2418–2468 retain same-bundle FS and continuous closure without EP; LF2894–2976 cover continuous envelopes; LF5468–5477 state and prove domination without EP; LF6302–6359 give orthogonality with its explicit EP assumption. BE https://arxiv.org/pdf/1805.01016v3: LF2358–2379,2611–2779,3125–3202 preserve pertinent smoothing, raw base-change and model Deligne statements and proofs. BJ PDF SHA256 is 8d5975337f4ac88a475929ea6a436ec4a15d08715d5582bc0ba0eb3e07152c52; BE retained text SHA256 is 8e584521fe3d41f179bef93d14315414ac7796532c65518c1861717416f99233. notes.detailedSummary: BJ1801.08229v4 permits reduced nonnormal projective varieties. Its general energy pairing constructs genuine positive mixed Radon measures, retaining central multiplicities and the original generic fiber. Raw energy and MA scale by V, and raw dual energy at mu equals V times probability dual energy at mu/V. notes.text:
Domain and claim. Let k be algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic zero, X reduced irreducible projective, possibly nonnormal and singular, and L an actual ample rational bundle. Put omega=c1(L), V=(L^n)>0. The genuine BJ finite-energy operator exists on this domain independently of EP. BJ explicitly allows reduced nonnormal varieties, Section7 resumes general projective scope, and the relevant energy, derivative, locality and uniqueness statements have that scope. The supplied accepted general-theory reconstruction is a scoped mathematical input; the pertinent primary construction is recorded here.

At a relatively integrally closed test configuration, retain the original generic fiber. Generic central local rings are DVRs. Set b_E=ord_E(t) and v_E=b_E^(−1)ord_E|k(X). Raw PL mixed curvature is the sum over E of b_E times the intersection of the restricted model classes on E, multiplied by delta_vE. Nefness gives positive coefficients and fundamental-cycle intersection gives raw mass (L1…Ln). Relative integral closure inside the prescribed generic fiber is essential; absolute normalization or removal of multiplicities is not substituted.

The symmetric intersection pairing extends through genuine Hdom majorants. Finite PL majorants and continuity of sup(phi−fixedPL) prove weak energy upper semicontinuity. Monotonicity and USC give decreasing-net continuity. Define E_raw(phi)=pairing((omega,phi)^(n+1))/(n+1), E_BJ=E_raw/V, and actual E1 as genuine PSH with energy greater than minus infinity. Mixed estimates make finite-energy pairings finite. Their signed multilinear extension takes place on the finite-energy vector space and does not subtract two minus-infinity point values.

For PL f, define ell(f)=pairing((0,f),(omega_1,phi_1),…,(omega_n,phi_n)). Positivity gives ell(f)≥0 for f≥0, while ell(1)=(L1…Ln). Thus |ell(f)|≤ell(1)||f||. PL density and Riesz representation construct the actual positive raw mixed Radon measure. The top product has mass V; MA_BJ=MA_raw/V is the same operator in probability convention.

For genuine unbounded decreasing nets with E1 limits, pairing continuity gives every PL test limit. Positivity, fixed intersection masses and uniform density extend this to continuous tests, proving weak mixed-measure convergence. For an integrable psh test phi0, the weighted integral is the test-containing pairing minus the zero-test pairing at both finite stages and the limit. Translate the test below zero and apply the positive weighted-measure convergence lemma to its negative. This handles unbounded weighted limits without calling differences of decreasing nets decreasing. The reversed order printed in BJ7.21(ii) is corrected by the defining identity.

For a positive Radon mu of raw mass V, set mubar=mu/V. Exactly MA_raw=V MA_BJ, E_raw=V E_BJ, and E_raw^dual(mu)=V E_BJ^dual(mubar), with the supremum over all actual E1 potentials. The objective is constant invariant at precisely this mass. Finite dual energy implies integrability of every E1 potential. Conversely, integrability bounds integrals of −phi uniformly on each normalized bounded-J set: otherwise decreasing sums of 2^(−j)phi_j with bounded energies yield a genuine E1 limit of infinite target integral. Apply this bound to t phi with t=J(phi)^(−1/2), using J(t phi)≤C_n t^2 J(phi), to obtain integral(−phi)≤A sqrt(J)+B. Since normalized E=−J, the dual supremum is finite. This is irreducible BJ9.20; it adds no support restriction.

Outer energy is defined on continuous obstacles by suprema below them and on upper-bounded usc functions by infima of continuous majorant energies. It is decreasing-net continuous and agrees with genuine energy on psh potentials. General-projective BJ8.5 gives, for fixed real PL f, E_BJ_down(phi+t f)=E_BJ(phi)+t integral(f MA_BJ(phi))+O(t^2), uniformly in genuine phi∈E1. The continuous proof uses differences of genuine PL entries, relative-volume estimates and positive mixed expansions with fixed raw masses. Genuine decreasing approximation passes this uniform estimate to unbounded E1 potentials. Negative t is handled with −f. For continuous f_m approximating f within epsilon_m, monotonicity and translation bound the energy error by |t|epsilon_m for both signs. Take the PL derivative first, then epsilon_m→0. Hence dE_raw_down(phi+t f)/dt at zero equals integral(f MA_raw(phi)). Under proved target EP, outer energy equals genuine envelope energy. Smoothness is not an antecedent of this primary derivative theorem.

Strict PL winning components have identical model divisors near the component, giving equality of raw coefficients. Weighted convergence applied termwise to max(phi,psi) and psi proves strict-winning Borel locality for unbounded E1. Displaced maxima and equal raw mass yield integral_{phi<psi} MA_raw(psi)≤integral_{phi<psi} MA_raw(phi). Polarization gives mixed open locality. In probability calibration, I(phi,psi)=integral((phi−psi)(MA_BJ(psi)−MA_BJ(phi)))≥0. General equidimensional BJ10.4 makes equal MA equivalent to I=0 and a locally constant difference. Its proof uses energy estimates against divisorial finite-energy Diracs and genuine divisorial determination, without first solving a Dirac equation. Irreducibility gives one constant. If a≤b almost everywhere for MA(b), replace a by max(a,b)∈E1; its I is also nonpositive, so I=0 and almost-everywhere equality fixes the constant. This is domination without EP, valid on the original nonnormal target.

notes.text:
Complete result claimed. The proof draft solves exact original P16.1 in the assigned retained domain: every algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero k with no countability assumption; every original reduced irreducible geometrically unibranch projective X, possibly nonnormal and singular; every actual ample rational L; all dimensions; and every positive Radon mu of raw mass V=(L^n) and finite intrinsic dual energy, with arbitrary support. The genuine equation MA_raw,L(phi_mu)=mu has an actual E1 solution unique modulo one real constant. Projectivity, algebraizability, trivial valuation, algebraic closedness, characteristic zero and ample actual rational polarization are retained. Other P16 axes are not claimed solved.

Dependencies. n1 reconstructs every countable contact, witness, growth, geometric and original-reference antecedent, proving first L-membership before EP, onto resolution PSH pullback, normalized compactness and the entire countable EP domain. n2 matches that domain to the exact task-granted finite-data implication, giving original EP without countability and every rational approaching target class. n3 supplies the genuine general-variety operator, positive raw mixed measures, intrinsic energy criterion, unbounded decreasing continuity, derivatives, comparison and uniqueness. The supplied partial bodies are assumptions only within their exact grants. The proposed continuation99 join and the separate frozen review are not premises.

Actual attainment. Set mubar=mu/V and D=E_BJ^dual(mubar)<infinity. Choose a genuine E1 maximizing sequence phi_j with sup phi_j=0. Constants cancel in the objective. Its nonnegative deficit J_mubar(phi_j)=D−E(phi_j)+integral(phi_j mubar) tends to zero. General-projective BJ9.15–9.16 bound J(phi_j) by C_n(J_mubar(phi_j)+D), hence uniformly eventually. Compactness of original normalized target PSH gives a weakly convergent subnet to an actual normalized psh phi. Lower semicontinuity of J gives J(phi)<infinity, so phi is actual E1. BJ9.19 supplies target L1 convergence on bounded-J weak nets. The corrected identity is |a−b|=2(max(a,b)−b)−(a−b). Energy USC therefore gives E(phi)−integral(phi mubar)≥limsup_j(E(phi_j)−integral(phi_j mubar))=D. The supremum definition gives the reverse inequality. The supremum is attained by this genuine potential. This is the general BJ12.8 attainment argument, using general5.11 compactness from EP; no smooth target, abstract completion or approximate maximizer is substituted.

Actual raw equation. For real PL f and real t, EP makes p_t=P(phi+t f) genuine E1, bounded between phi−|t|||f|| and phi+|t|||f||. Outer raw energy equals E_raw(p_t). Since p_t≤phi+t f, its genuine objective bounds E_raw_down(phi+t f)−integral((phi+t f)mu) from above; every genuine objective is at most the attained supremum. Thus E_raw_down(phi+t f)−integral((phi+t f)mu)≤E_raw(phi)−integral(phi mu). The raw derivative in n3 gives integral(f MA_raw(phi))≤integral(f mu) for t>0. Applying −f, or dividing with t<0 and reversing the inequality, gives the opposite inequality. All PL test integrals coincide. Uniform PL density and the common raw mass V identify the actual positive Radon measures: MA_raw(phi)=mu. Exactly E_raw=V E_BJ and E_raw^dual(mu)=V E_BJ^dual(mu/V). Equal MA implies I=0 and a locally constant difference by general equidimensional uniqueness; irreducibility gives one real constant. The intrinsic dual-energy condition is precisely integrability of every actual E1 potential and introduces no additional support restriction.

Normalization after EP. Only now use the actual finite universal-homeomorphism normalization nu:Xnu→X. All target classes (1+1/m)omega have EP and differ amply from omega. BJ5.13 therefore gives onto genuine PSH pullback at omega. Generic degree is one: nu_*[Xnu]=[X], and (nu*L)^n=V. Finite actual-bundle PL stages preserve energy pairings and every fundamental-cycle and vertical multiplicity. Continuous compatibility preserves the original canonical reference and generic fiber. Genuine decreasing approximation on original X then preserves equal energies, including minus infinity; onto PSH becomes onto E1. For finite-energy tuples, mixed raw pushforward follows from genuine decreasing-net convergence against PL and continuous tests, fixed raw masses and weak continuity of pushforward. Integrable unbounded weights pass by test-containing minus zero-test pairing, rather than bounded convergence. The analytic homeomorphism preserves potential integrals, and onto E1 with raw energy identities preserves intrinsic dual suprema. The equation target remains original possibly nonnormal X. The resolution's nonample pullback was only an auxiliary input to first membership and compactness.

Dimension zero. Reduced irreducible projective X over algebraically closed k is literally one point. V=1, scalar potentials have energy equal to that scalar, and raw MA is the unit point measure. The unique positive target of mass one has dual energy zero; all scalars solve the equation and differ by constants. Positive-dimensional estimates are unnecessary.
